description: Benchmark questions for scoring retrieval (Block 11) and answers (Block 12). Relevance is judged at speech level: a retrieved chunk counts through chunk.speech_id. Labels are incomplete by nature, since other speeches may also answer a question, so report recall against the known-relevant speeches. status 'provisional' means drafted from the corpus and every evidence_quote machine-checked to exist, but not yet reviewed by the owner; set 'verified' after review. 25 queries is a smoke-test size: Block 12 needs 50+ for confident comparisons.

categories.exact_term: Hinges on a distinctive name, phrase or figure: keyword search should do well.
categories.paraphrase: Deliberately shares almost no wording with the answer: dense (vector) search should do well.
categories.numeric_fact: The answer is a specific figure inside one sentence.
categories.named_speaker: Names the MP or peer. The name is not in chunk.body, so plain text search cannot use it.
categories.multi_speech: The full answer spans two or more speeches; every listed speech is relevant.
categories.abstain: Sounds answerable but the topic is not in the corpus: the system must say 'not in the record'.

queries.question: What action has the Government taken to hold Capita to account for poor service?

relevant.evidence_quote: As I said, we have deployed 147 surge staff to help during this crisis—they will not be removed until service levels are brought up to scratch—we are withholding contractual payments, and an independent Capita-funded remedial adviser has been appointed to identify further issues.

Current service levels are completely unacceptable, and we are holding Capita accountable by withholding payments in the short term and assessing the long-term viability of bringing the scheme in-house.

queries.notes: Two ministerial answers on different days' questions.
